Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, pt As Object, c As Range, s As String, sh As Object
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Name = "data"
    ws.Range("A1:C1").Value = Array("Region", "Product", "Amount")
    ws.Range("A2:C2").Value = Array("East", "Pen", 10)
    ws.Range("A3:C3").Value = Array("West", "Ink", 20)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=ws)
    ws.Name = "report"
    Set pt = wb.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase, "data!R1C1:R3C3").CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("A3"), "P")
    pt.PivotFields("Region").Orientation = xlRowField
    pt.AddDataField pt.PivotFields("Amount"), "Sum of Amount", xlSum
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        pt.ListFormulas
    Case 1
        pt.CalculatedFields.Add "Bonus", "=Amount*0.1": pt.ListFormulas
    Case 2
        pt.CalculatedFields.Add "Bonus", "=Amount*0.1": pt.CalculatedFields.Add "Twice", "=Amount*2": pt.ListFormulas
    Case 3
        pt.CalculatedFields.Add "Bonus", "=Amount*0.1": pt.ListFormulas: pt.ListFormulas
    Case 4
        pt.PivotFields("Region").CalculatedItems.Add "Both", "=East+West": pt.ListFormulas
    Case 5
        pt.CalculatedFields.Add "Bonus", "=Amount*0.1": pt.PivotFields("Region").CalculatedItems.Add "Both", "=East+West": pt.ListFormulas
    Case 6
        pt.CalculatedFields.Add "Bonus", "=Amount*0.1": s = TypeName(pt.ListFormulas)
    Case 7
        pt.CalculatedFields.Add "Bonus", "=Amount*0.1": wb.Sheets("data").Activate: pt.ListFormulas
    End Select
    For Each sh In wb.Sheets: s = s & "|" & sh.Name: Next
    s = s & "|active=" & ActiveSheet.Name
    If ActiveSheet.Name <> "report" Then
        For Each c In ActiveSheet.UsedRange.Cells
            If Not IsEmpty(c.Value) Then s = s & "|" & c.Address(False, False) & ":" & c.Formula & ":" & c.NumberFormat & ":" & c.Font.Bold
        Next
    End If
    Tried = "ok " & s
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    For i = 0 To 7
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i)
    Next
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
